name: Sundial
tagline: A calendar guard that spots collisions and protects focus time
description: It watches your connected calendar for commitments that collide and days that have quietly filled up, flagging both before they bite. Deadlines and deep-work blocks are treated as fixed points, and no invite goes out to anyone until you say so.
author: WaterMixing
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
